title: Information Broker — Operations
description: Health and throughput of the Information Broker pipeline: RSS ingest, summarizer, Discord delivery, API and runtime. Needs a Prometheus data source scraping the service's /metrics endpoint.

panels.title: Service
panels.description: Whether Prometheus can scrape the Information Broker metrics endpoint.

panels.title: Alerts firing
panels.description: Prometheus alerts currently firing (rules in prometheus/rules).

panels.title: Articles stored
panels.description: Total articles in the database.

panels.title: New articles
panels.description: Articles first seen during the selected time range (respects the Feed filter).

panels.title: Fetch success
panels.description: Share of RSS fetches that succeeded in the range. Baseline is ~94%: a handful of feeds fail permanently (WAF, parse errors). Green ≥ 93%, yellow ≥ 85%, orange ≥ 70%, red below.

panels.title: Summaries OK
panels.description: Share of summarization requests that succeeded in the range. Green ≥ 99%, yellow ≥ 95%, orange ≥ 80%, red below.

panels.title: Discord delivery
panels.description: Share of Discord webhook posts that succeeded in the range (— when nothing was posted). Green ≥ 99%, yellow ≥ 97%, orange ≥ 90%, red below.

panels.title: Feeds erroring
panels.description: Feeds with at least one fetch error in the range. ~11 is the normal baseline. Green < 15, yellow ≥ 15, orange ≥ 25, red ≥ 40.

panels.title: Articles ingested (rolling hour)
panels.description: New articles stored in the trailing hour.

panels.title: Top sources by new articles
panels.description: The ten feeds that produced the most new articles in the range.

panels.title: RSS fetches by outcome (per 30 min)
panels.description: Fetch attempts in the trailing 30 minutes (one fetch cycle), split by success and error.

panels.title: Fetch latency
panels.description: Time to fetch and extract one feed's items, over the trailing 30 minutes.

panels.title: Queue fill
panels.description: Summary queue depth as a share of its capacity. Green < 50%, yellow ≥ 50%, orange ≥ 80%, red ≥ 95% (new requests are rejected when full).

panels.title: Queue depth
panels.description: Pending summarization requests against the queue's capacity.

panels.title: Time to summarize
panels.description: How long the model takes, and how long requests wait in the queue first (trailing 30 minutes).

panels.title: Summaries by outcome (rolling hour)
panels.description: Summarization requests in the trailing hour, split by outcome.

panels.title: LLM API latency (p95)
panels.description: p95 latency of calls to the model server over the trailing 30 minutes, per model.

panels.title: Discord posts (per hour)
panels.description: Webhook posts in the trailing hour, by outcome.

panels.title: Discord latency (p95)
panels.description: p95 time to post one article to Discord over the trailing hour.

panels.title: API requests (per min)
panels.description: Requests per minute to the Information Broker API: the four main endpoints, and everything else combined.

panels.title: API latency (p95)
panels.description: p95 response time across all API endpoints.

panels.title: Feeds with errors
panels.description: Fetch errors per feed and error type in the selected range, worst first.

panels.title: Fetch errors by type (per 30 min)
panels.description: Fetch errors in the trailing 30 minutes (one fetch cycle) by cause.

panels.title: Articles stored over time
panels.description: Database growth.

panels.title: Database connections
panels.description: Open database connections by state.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Process memory of the Information Broker service.

panels.title: Goroutines
panels.description: A steady climb here suggests a leak.
